verdict.rationale: Ollama exposes a documented REST API (ollama-gh-4) with local/cloud base URLs, curl examples, and Python/JS SDKs (ollama-docs-9/10/11), and llms.txt confirms 'a simple API and 40,000+ integrations' (ollama-probe-1). No formal OpenAPI spec is discoverable (ollama-probe-3), but the API is otherwise clearly documented and widely used by community tools/agents (ollama-gh-1, ollama-comm-4/5).
